data.name: "Otilukes Freezing Sphere" for Sorcerers
data.summary: Makes Otiluke's Freezing Sphere available for Sorcerors. Can be chosen at SL4, although the spell is slighty nerfed here to 8d6 Cold. Can be upcast to do addtional 2d6 Cold damage.

modfile.changelog: No longer overrides vanilla spell lists.

data.name: (Greater) Deathstalker Mantle
data.summary: Replaces the Deathstalker Mantle with (Greather) Deathstalker Mantle which works the same way but you get greater invisibility instead and advantage on stealth checks, (I honestly don't think it's THAT op)

data.name: (Lightning & Force Cantrips) Raijin / Fujin
data.summary: Paired Lightning and Force cantrips, both with a potential thunder effect. For Wizards, Sorcerer, Druid, Fighter Eldritch Knight, Warlock, and Cleric. Also adds highest spellcasting modfifier to be applied if added via racial cantrip.

modfile.changelog: Updated cantrip lists so that they show the new cantrips that were missing (Bursting Sinew and Booming Blade)

data.name: (MF) Artificer's Armorer Dreadnaught UA
data.summary: This adds the 2024 Artificer UA of the dreadnaught Model to the Armorer Subclass Level 3 Weapon: One flail that deals 1d10 of bludgeoning damage and pushes targets back Armor Model: Immunity to Frighten, and restores 3 hitpoints per turn

modfile.changelog: Added pulling flail option in inventory when summoning flails; which cannot be duel weilded

data.name: (MF) Artificer's More Dialogue & Deities
data.summary: Another Add-on to my Artificer's Mod that allows for more dialogue options for Artificer- including paladin, cleric, dwarf, rogue and bard. It also enables Artificers to choose a deity.

modfile.changelog:
Added Bard Dialogue as an option
Added general Cleric Dialogue
Added general Paladin Dialogue
Added full deity function

data.name: (Mostly) Faithful Artificer Mod
data.summary: This mod is meant to be a (mostly) faithful re-creation of the long-lost 13th Class. Comes with 4 subclasses and tons of infusions to explore! (Warning: Still is a work in progress, currently fixing a few things, any feedback is appreciated!)

modfile.changelog:
Fixed glitch with Constitution Saving Throw not being given at lvl 1
Added Booming Blade cantrip to Artificer Spell List
Added Longsword as Enhanced Weapon Option
Improved Enhanced Defense Armor Choices

data.name: (Naruto) Shinobi Class Mod
data.summary: Shinobi Class inspired by Naruto. Currently features Indra's Path, based on Sasuke Uchiha's abilities, with plans for Asura's Path (Naruto) in the future. Fully playable to level 12. with scaling to level 20. Spellcasting uses wisdom.
